ghi: Phản đối thật (YouTube) "stretch jeans sẽ giãn". ⚠ trang bán chỉ ghi "not too loose · withstand regular wear and washing" — không có câu "không giãn"; video chứng minh bằng hình, không hứa. ⚠ anh_tran_an đang dùng tạm ảnh sản phẩm — cần ảnh bảng size/đổi trả thật. 15/10/2026.

o.san_pham_hinh: Men's stretch pants that look like smooth dress trousers cut from denim — NOT classic five-pocket jeans. High rise, straight leg, relaxed but not baggy. Flat front; two slanted (slash) front pockets; NO coin pocket, NO rivets, NO contrast or gold stitching (stitching is tonal, same color as the fabric); zip fly with a single button; belt loops; two back pockets with button-through closure. Fabric: smooth, uniform, solid-color stretch denim twill with a soft sheen — NO fading, NO whiskering, NO distressing, NO wash marks. Main color Light Blue (vivid cobalt/royal blue).
o.diem_noi_bat: Soft stretch denim (94% cotton, 4% elastane) that moves when he sits, bends or squats; straight relaxed fit, not too tight, not too loose; high rise; deep pockets that don't dig in when sitting; slant front pockets, button-through back pockets, zip fly with button; machine washable, wrinkle resistant, breathable; waist W29–W50, length L28–L34; 6 colors (Light Blue, Medium Blue, Dark Blue, Black, Gray, Brown); $34.99 (was $119.99), extra 10% off the 2nd item; 45-day returns; 615 already purchased.
o.doi_tuong: Đàn ông Mỹ 55–75 tuổi mặc jeans cứng: cạp cấn bụng khi ngồi, đũng chảy, phải thắt lưng chặt; và người vợ hay mua đồ hộ chồng.
